subject: Insurance
title: Carbon Credit Insurance
description: A quick win: understand Carbon Credit Insurance.

hook.text: Companies buy carbon credits to offset emissions—then discover the forest they paid to protect was logged anyway.

buildup.text: The voluntary carbon market exceeded $2 billion in 2021.

discovery.text: Carbon credit insurance guarantees the offset is real.

climax.text: Carbon credit insurance creates a market for environmental trust. It insures promises about the planet's future.

punchline.text: Buy a carbon credit, insure it's real. Trust in climate action, guaranteed.

quiz.question: What does carbon credit insurance protect against?
options: The risk that a purchased carbon offset turns out to be invalid or destroyed
